precepts.text: Truth shall spring out of the earth. Opening the Bible is how the lies are swallowed up.
precepts.point: Having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience when your obedience is fulfilled. Brothers want to be on the Saturday night specials casting out demons in the street, but you cannot revenge disobedience until there is no impediment to sin left in your own spirit, your household, and your children.

note.label: The Divine Orchestration and Purpose of the People You Encounter

precepts.why:
“For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds”. You are at war right now in your spirit, with evil temptations pushed on every front: family members, school, work, even your own thoughts as you sit here. The weapons are not guns; the weapons are the commandments of God, and they are mighty.

Mighty to pull down what? Lies. That is what the Bible does; that is how we tear the lies down. We open up the Bible and swallow up the lies, like it says in the Psalms: “Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.” We open this Bible, and the lies are swallowed up.

So “Casting down imaginations” is casting down lies, “and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God”, and the knowledge of God is the law, the Bible. When you open this Bible and apply the commandments, you get rid of those impulsive, sinful thoughts and bring every thought “into captivity” under the obedience of Christ. That is how you walk straight past your temptation.

note.label: Job 20: The Triumphing of the Wicked Is Short

precepts.why:
“Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.” That is the uncovering happening now. Verses 5 and 11 are going on right now: the truth is springing out of the earth and this Bible is revealing him.

Though the wicked man's excellency mounts up to the heavens and his head reaches to the clouds, “he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?” He flies away as a dream and is chased away as a vision of the night. And “His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.” The short triumph of the wicked and the buried sin of his youth are being uncovered in this age, as truth springs out of the earth.

points: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven. God going to look down upon us and the truth going to come out. Right now you see their tongue falling upon themselves: they lying, getting caught up in their lies, and telling on each other.

News discussed in class: in the Nolan Wells case the examiner removed the brother's throat and certain organs to determine whether he drowned; and around Juneteenth several of our people were found hanging from trees and it was ruled suicide. The Lord going to make the truth come out of this case and many other cases. Trust me, the Lord going to let us know what's really going on behind the scenes.

note.label: Psalm 85: Turn Us, O God of Our Salvation

points: He has taken away all His wrath and turned Himself from the fierceness of His anger; David asks Him to turn His people again, O God of their salvation, and cause His anger toward them to cease.

note.label: Psalm 85: Turn Us, O God of Our Salvation

points: The prayer asks whether the Most High will be angry forever and draw out His anger to all generations, and pleads that He revive His people again that they may rejoice in Him, showing them His mercy and granting His salvation.

note.label: Psalm 85: Turn Us, O God of Our Salvation

points: David will hear what God the Lord will speak, for He will speak peace unto His people and to His saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

note.label: Psalm 85: Turn Us, O God of Our Salvation

points: Surely His salvation is nigh them that fear Him, that glory may dwell in the land; mercy and truth are met together, righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

note.label: Psalm 85: Turn Us, O God of Our Salvation

points: Truth shall spring out of the earth and righteousness shall look down from heaven; the Lord shall give that which is good and the land shall yield her increase, and righteousness shall go before Him and set us in the way of His steps.
